knowledge.question: What do the priority levels mean?
knowledge.keywords: priority high medium low levels meaning hot warm cold filter
knowledge.answer: Leads carry a **priority** of *High*, *Medium*, or *Low*. High-priority leads — often *No Website* prospects with strong scores — have the greatest conversion potential and should be worked first. You can filter the **Leads** list by priority.

knowledge.question: What lead statuses exist in the pipeline?
knowledge.keywords: status statuses pipeline stages new interested awaiting reply call back declined workflow update
knowledge.answer: A lead moves through **New → Interested → Awaiting Reply → Call-back Req. → Declined**. Status reflects where the conversation stands (not the lead's quality — that's the *score*). Set it from a lead's detail page, and filter the **Leads** list by status.

knowledge.question: What does website status mean for a lead?
knowledge.keywords: website status no website needs redesign has website site web presence filter segment
knowledge.answer: **Website status** classifies a prospect's online presence: *No Website* (highest conversion potential), *Needs Redesign* (outdated or underperforming), or *Has Website* (satisfied but receptive). It feeds the lead score, and the **Leads** list can filter by it.

knowledge.question: How do I add a new lead?
knowledge.keywords: add lead new create wizard manually enter business record
knowledge.answer: On the **Leads** page, use **New Lead** (Create) to open the add-lead wizard, then enter the business, contact, website status, and other details. The lead is scored automatically once saved.

knowledge.question: How do I import leads?
knowledge.keywords: import leads csv upload bulk add file mapping duplicates spreadsheet
knowledge.answer: On the **Leads** page choose **Import** to upload a **CSV**. You map each column to a CRM field, preview a summary (valid rows, duplicates, and errors), then commit. Duplicate emails are flagged so you don't create the same lead twice.

knowledge.question: How do I export leads?
knowledge.keywords: export leads csv download filter current view report spreadsheet
knowledge.answer: The **Export** button on **Leads** downloads a **CSV**. It's *filter-aware* — you get exactly the leads matching your current search, priority, status, website-status, and niche filters.

knowledge.question: What is on a lead's detail page?
knowledge.keywords: lead detail details page open view profile score ring header sections tabs
knowledge.answer: Open any lead from the **Leads** table to reach its detail page: the **score** ring, **priority** and **status**, **Edit**, **Assign** owner, discussion **Notes**, the **Activity Timeline**, and *Draft & send email*.

knowledge.question: How do notes on a lead work?
knowledge.keywords: notes note discussion internal comment add write team lead detail
knowledge.answer: Each lead's detail page has **Discussion Notes** — internal notes your team can add, edit, and delete. Every note change is recorded in **Activity Logs** so there's a full audit trail.

knowledge.question: What do the Quick Actions on a lead do?
knowledge.keywords: quick actions lead detail card email call schedule follow up mark contacted buttons wired
knowledge.answer: On a lead's detail page, the **Quick Actions** card currently wires up only *Draft & send email*. *Log a call*, *Schedule follow-up*, and *Mark as contacted* are shown but not yet functional — they're placeholders for a later sprint.

knowledge.question: How is lead ownership and assignment handled?
knowledge.keywords: ownership assigned assignment owner assign to me unassigned bdm reassign visibility scope
knowledge.answer: Assign or change a lead's owner from its detail page with **Assign**. Visibility follows ownership: a **BDM** sees only the leads assigned to them, while **Admins** and **Super Admins** see every lead. There's no *unassigned* list filter yet.

knowledge.question: How does outreach and email work?
knowledge.keywords: outreach email emails send draft compose reply thread inbox follow ups composer
knowledge.answer: **Outreach** (the follow-ups inbox) is where you compose and **send** email to a lead — sending is real and gets logged to the activity feed. Not built yet: saved **drafts**, **scheduled** send, reply tracking, and attachments. You can also send from a lead's *Draft & send email* action.

knowledge.question: What counts as a follow-up?
knowledge.keywords: follow up follow-ups due reminder next step overdue outreach reply awaiting call back
knowledge.answer: In **Outreach**, leads are grouped by where the conversation stands — *Awaiting Reply*, *Call-back Req.*, and so on. Note that an outbound email is **not** itself a follow-up, and there's no dedicated follow-up scheduler yet.

knowledge.question: What is in the Activity Logs?
knowledge.keywords: activity activities logs feed history audit events login logout note email created updated assigned timeline
knowledge.answer: **Activity Logs** is an append-only, ownership-scoped feed: lead created/updated/deleted, emails sent and received, note changes, assignments, and sign-ins. The same feed powers the Dashboard's *Recent Activity*.

knowledge.question: What is on the dashboard?
knowledge.keywords: dashboard home kpis widgets management bd role based total leads status live placeholder
knowledge.answer: The **Dashboard** is role-based. Live now: *Total Leads*, *High Priority*, *Interested*, the *Leads by Status* breakdown, and recent leads & activity (Admins also see *BD Performance* and *Lead Acquisition*). Display-only until the KPI Engine: *Follow-ups Due*, *Completed Outreach*, *Conversion Rate*, and the date-range filter.

knowledge.question: What is on My Performance?
knowledge.keywords: performance my stats kpis assigned leads conversion revenue targets discipline
knowledge.answer: **My Performance** is your own scorecard, computed live: *Conversion Rate*, *Converted*, *Revenue*, *Estimated Pipeline*, *Active* and *Assigned* leads, *Completed Follow-ups*, plus *Follow-up Discipline* and *Recent Activity*. Ask me how any of them is computed. Only *Personal Target* is Pending — the CRM has no monthly-goal source, so no progress can be shown. The range selector and Export PDF on this page are still Demo affordances.

knowledge.question: What user roles are there?
knowledge.keywords: roles role permissions super admin admin bdm business developer manager access rbac who can reports settings
knowledge.answer: Three roles: **Super Admin** and **Admin** (CRM Manager) with full visibility, and **Business Development Manager (BDM)** who works their assigned leads. *Reports* and *Settings* are Admin-only, and the Dashboard's content adapts to your role.

knowledge.question: Is there a Companies section?
knowledge.keywords: companies company module section workspace business accounts organization search
knowledge.answer: There's no **Companies** module in the app today — no such page or route exists. Each company's details live on its **Lead** instead, on the **Leads** page.

knowledge.question: What can the Vite Copilot do?
knowledge.keywords: copilot assistant help what can you do commands capabilities ai vite rule based
knowledge.answer: The **Vite Copilot** is a rule-based assistant — no external AI. It surfaces hot leads and follow-ups and drafts outreach copy from sample data, answers questions about how the CRM works, and jumps you to any workspace. Sending an email is a real action; some figures it previews are sample data.
